papers.title: Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization
papers.summary: Composing complementary continual learning mechanisms substantially improves long-horizon memorization in language models by combining data, function, and weight anchors with merged low-rank updates.

papers.title: Lightning Weave: Improving the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier of Reasoning Models through Capability Composition
papers.summary: Lightning Weave composes independently trained reasoning capabilities into a single efficient student via on-policy distillation, improving both accuracy and token efficiency across math and code benchmarks.
